mapper.select: SELECT * FROM final_movie ORDER BY movie_code DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE final_movie SET title = #{title}, director = #{director}, genre = #{genre}, story = #{story}, poster = #{poster, jdbcType=CLOB}, release_date = #{release_date} WHERE movie_code = #{movie_code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO final_movie (movie_code, title, director, genre, story, poster, release_date) VALUES (final_movie_seq.nextval, #{title}, #{director}, #{genre}, #{story}, #{poster}, #{release_date})
